purpose: Mapping verified Canva-generated AIL LABS product mockups to catalog SKUs.

production_policy.reason: Canva asset links are not yet proven to be permanent public browser URLs; keep production foto_url unchanged until stable public hosting is verified.

notes: Only assets whose generation job reached SUCCESS and whose Canva asset metadata returned import_status=success are included.
Canva connector exposes asset IDs and thumbnails, but not a permanent public CDN URL suitable for production foto_url.
The canva_asset_url uses the Canva asset-open URL pattern previously returned in this workflow; production should not depend on it until public persistence is verified.
Failed/unverifiable generation jobs are intentionally excluded rather than mapped speculatively.
